t: How many numbers which are smaller than 945 but greater than 360 are neither divisible by 4 nor by 9?
e:
Numbers which are not divisible by both 4 and 9 = numbers not divisible by 4 + numbers not divisible by 9 - numbers not divisible by LCM of 4 and 9
LCM of 4 and 9 = 36
Now, total numbers between 360 and 945 = 584
We find the numbers among these 584 numbers which are divisible by 4, 9 and 36.
Numbers divisible by 4 = 364, 368 .., 944, i.e., there are 146 numbers.
Numbers divisible by 9 = 369, 378 .., 936, i.e., there are 64 numbers.
Numbers divisible by 36 = 396, 432, .., 936, i.e., there are 16 numbers.
So, numbers divisible by both 4 and 9 = 146 + 64 - 16 = 194
Hence, numbers not divisible by both 4 and 9 = 584 - 194 = 390 numbers

t: Sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 11 and number obtained after reversing its digit becomes 27 less than the original number, then find the original number.

Original number = x * 10 + (11 - x) = 10x + 11 - x = (9x + 11)
Number obtained after reversing the digits = 10 (11 - x) + x = 110 - 10x + x = (110 - 9x)

18x = 27 + 110 - 11
18x = 126
x = 7
Original number = 9x + 11
= 63 + 11
= 74

25% of (x + y) = 13/4 = 3.25

t: How many zeroes are there in the product of 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6!?

= 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1
= 6

t: The digit on tens place of a two-digit number is 4/3 of the digit on ones place. When the digits are interchanged, the difference between both the numbers is 18. Find the sum of the digits of the number.
e:
Let the digit on ones place = 3m
Digit on tens place = 4m
According to the question-
(10*4m + 3m) - (10*3m + 4m) = 18
43m - 34m = 18
m = 2
So, the number = 86
Required sum = 8 + 6 = 14
h: दो अंकों वाली एक संख्या के दहाई के अंक इकाई के अंक का 4/3 है। जब अंकों को आपस में बदल दिया जाता है, तो दोनों संख्याओं के बीच का अंतर 18 होता है। संख्या के अंकों का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: How many natural numbers are there between 103 and 460 which are divisible by 9?
e:
First number that is divisible by 9 = 108
Last number that is divisible by 9 = 459
Difference = 9
Total number of terms or numbers between 108 and 459 = [(459 - 108)/9] + 1 = 40
h: 103 और 460 के बीच कितनी प्राकृतिक संख्याएँ हैं जो 9 से विभाज्य हैं?

t: How many factors of 2<sup>4</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> * 5<sup>7</sup> * 7<sup>3</sup> are divisible by 42 but not by 84?
e:
42 = 2 * 3 * 7
84 = 2<sup>2</sup> * 3 * 7
Now, to have number divisible by 42 and not by 84. We have to make sure that 2 is taken only once. As, if we pick 2 two's, then it will form 84 with no. of 3 and 7 selected and since minimum 3 and 7 we have to select is 1, we cannot have 2 more than one.
Number= 2<sup>4</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> * 5<sup>7</sup> * 7<sup>3</sup>
So, there are 2 ways of picking 3, 8 ways of picking 3, 3 ways of picking 7 and only one way of picking 2 and that is 2<sup>1</sup>.
So, total number of ways = 1 * 2 * 8 * 3 = 48
h: 2<sup>4</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> * 5<sup>7</sup> * 7<sup>3</sup> के कितने गुणनखंड 42 से विभाज्य हैं लेकिन 84 से नहीं?
